styles.name: Soft Hours
styles.line: Cozy and slow. A dim warm room, soft typed captions. Works faceless or on camera.

styles.name: Glam Cam
styles.line: Studio beauty close-up. A jump zoom on every new thought, one serif word at a time.

styles.name: Color Block
styles.line: A day in the life told in pieces, broken up by flat color cards and huge lowercase words.

styles.name: Camera Shy
styles.line: A tips list. Quick cuts, a pinned title, your points typed onto the frame. Works faceless or on camera.

styles.name: Chalk Talk
styles.line: You on a dark studio backdrop, with hand-drawn marker titles and a rounded b-roll card.

styles.name: Fireside
styles.line: One locked-off shot, warm lamp light, no cuts. The words do the work.

styles.name: Raw Tape
styles.line: A sit-down left alone. A 4:3 picture, a faded film look, small yellow subtitles.

styles.name: Show and Tell
styles.line: You in a window at the bottom, a clean light canvas above for labels, cards and the call to action.
